definitions.explanation: Attached to verb stems to indicate difficulty in performing an action.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧にくい。
examples.english: This kanji is hard to read.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧にくくて⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: These shoes are hard to walk in, and my feet hurt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧にくい⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is something that's hard to say to the teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{説明書|せつめいしょ}→説明書：19368_setsumeisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さくて→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧にくいので、⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ほしい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: This manual has small text and is hard to read, so I want it written larger.

notes:
～にくい is an auxiliary adjective attached to verb stems to express difficulty in doing something.

FORMS:
Verb stem (ます form without ます) + にくい
⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ → ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧ + にくい → ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧にくい

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧にくい: hard to read
- ⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧にくい: hard to understand
- ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧にくい: hard to eat
- ⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧にくい: hard to use
- ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧にくい: hard to say
- ⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧にくい: hard to walk (in)

CONJUGATES AS I-ADJECTIVE:
- ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧にくかった: was hard to read
- ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧にくくない: not hard to read

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦～やすい→～やすい：18367_yasui⟧: easy to ~
